'When Aether Slash attacks, if a non-attack action card was pitched to play it, deal 1 arcane damage to any target.'

PITCHED_FOR_THIS is the cards pitched to pay for THIS card, which play._pitch_for_cost stamps on it -- distinct from the pitch ZONE (which holds everything pitched this turn, so it would still be true on a later attack) and from combat.pitched_for_attack (the weapon-activate path).

'NON-ATTACK ACTION CARD' IS TWO CLAIMS ABOUT ONE CARD: it is an Action and it is not an Attack. `not_subtype` says that; a NOT around the whole condition would say something weaker -- 'no attack was pitched' -- which is wrong the moment both an attack and a non-attack pay for the same card, exactly the state the clause is about.
